title: A controlled path to shared AI capability
subtitle: A controlled pilot, an accountable decision.
label: Consulting
summary: A sample strategy presentation connecting an AI pilot to priorities, accountability and an investment decision.
note: Northstar Advisory is fictional. The figures are illustrative planning assumptions.

slides.title: Prove the research pilot before scaling AI
slides.claim: A $25k, 12-week research pilot makes the scale decision testable through explicit quality, adoption and value gates.

slides.title: Start where value and control readiness meet
slides.claim: Capacity hypotheses are transparent. Source readiness and review accountability determine the first release.

slides.title: Keep expert ownership at every release
slides.claim: Approved sources flow into grounded drafts, expert review and authorized delivery, with explicit correction paths.

slides.title: Run the pilot through four evidence gates
slides.claim: Four workstreams progress across four time windows, with named owners, evidence gates and dependencies.

slides.title: Release the next investment against evidence
slides.claim: The full first-year cost, ramp and three scenarios determine whether the remaining investment should be released.

process.title: Start with a decision
process.description: The authored outline gives every page a conclusion and specifies the evidence, calculation and responsibility it must carry.

process.title: Expose the assumptions
process.description: The baseline, adoption, time reduction, cost and ramp are explicit. Sample quality gates remain separate from approval of each client release.

process.title: Explore the content area
process.description: One compiled brief carries the argument and shared design into a 2:1 body image. The PowerPoint adds the common frame.

process.title: Identify meaningful editable objects
process.description: The host identifies one native chart, two tables and the supporting decision text before constructing the page.

process.title: Measure the chosen regions
process.description: OpenCV records visible ink and geometry within authored regions. The Agent interprets those measurements and inspects the overlay.

process.title: Construct the native page
process.description: A compiled scene preserves the chart data, table cells, text and geometry through the packaged PowerPoint renderer.

process.title: Check the actual PowerPoint
process.description: The generated target and the real rendered output are retained together. The native chart labels remain linked to the workbook.

process.title: Calibrate across the deck
process.description: The Agent compares all five rendered pages and aligns recurring titles, type sizes and decision bands. The review keeps the observed differences and their corrections.

process.title: Review the full argument
process.description: The review records observations across the slides, editable structures and remaining visual differences.

process.title: Edit the existing PowerPoint
process.description: An existing title and chart workbook are edited in a copy. The research value changes from 1,944 to 1,620 and its native label updates in the actual render. This demonstration leaves the official scenario unchanged.
